text:
kate: heads-up — noticed inconsistent client-visible codes across routing fallback and quota responses. console tooltips show `RATE_LIMIT` while API returns 429 + body `{ code: \"quota_exceeded\" }`. this is confusing for SDKs and customer-facing docs. should we pick a canonical `error_code` field to surface?

sam: +1. this ambiguity breaks client logic. we currently have http status + internal code + a freeform message. propose a thin canonical layer that SDKs can rely on.

arjun: agreed. proposal: API always includes a top-level `error_code` (string) and optional `hints` array. http status stays coarse-grained (4xx vs 5xx). console maps `error_code` -> user-friendly copy. example response:```{
  "status": 429,
  "error_code": "quota_exceeded",
  "hints": ["retry_after:120"]
}```

lina: one caveat: some internal fallbacks intentionally return 200 with a warning payload (we surface degraded content). we mustn't hide terminal failures that happen after routing. maybe add a small `severity` enum so console knows when to badge as failure vs degraded.

matt: prefer to avoid deep nesting so client libs don't need custom parsers. top-level `error_code` + `hints` (string list) + `retry_after` numeric is fine. example:```{
  "error_code": "quota_exceeded",
  "status": 429,
  "retry_after": 120,
  "hints": ["consider_reducing_batch_size"]
}```

kate: sounds reasonable. tradeoffs: we want machine-parseable canonical enum for routing (retryable / non-retryable / fallback) and human text for console. action items: sam to draft RFC for canonical `error_code` + hint semantics; eng-platform to wire console tooltip mapping; devex to update SDK parsing. @sam can you put a short one-pager in the repo? :thumbsup:

sam: will do. i'll draft a minimal RFC with examples, migration plan, and telemetry hooks. suggested telemetry fields: `exposed_error`, `hint_shown`, `user_action`. that'll let us A/B different phrasing in the console.

ops-bot: deploy-notify: canary rollout for error-mapping-v1 scheduled 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC.

arjun: also add unit tests for idempotent client flows — ensure retryable flag is explicit so SDKs won't double-retry.

lina: +1 — i'll add console unit tests for tooltip copy and hover-state badges.

matt: fwiw, we should include a migration shim: accept existing `code` and `error` fields and normalize into `error_code` server-side for a 2-week window. then flip strict parsing in SDKs.

kate: good call. i'll update the RFC ask to include a 2-week compatibility period and a console rollout plan. thanks everyone.
